name: footgun
description: Dated, verified traps for third-party APIs, platforms, and AI tools, loaded before your agent hits them.

api_key.title: Footgun API key
api_key.description: Optional. Needed to confirm traps and to file privately. Create one at https://getfootgun.com/account

auto_context.title: Automatic trap notes
auto_context.description: Adds a short note of known traps for this project's package versions at the start of each session. Your code never leaves your machine. Needs Node 20 or later. On by default; set to false to turn it off.

auto_search.title: Search traps when a command fails
auto_search.description: When a shell command fails, sends its error text, with secrets and file paths removed, to Footgun's trap search and shows a strong match next to the error. Never sends the command or your code. On by default; set to false to send nothing (the retry-loop warning still works).

safety_net.title: Pause before destructive commands
safety_net.description: Before a shell command runs, checks it on your machine for things that are hard to undo, like dropping a database, destroying servers, force pushing over main or deleting the project folder, and asks you first. In a git repo it also saves an undo point of your files when a session starts, which /footgun:undo restores. Nothing is sent anywhere. On by default; set to false to turn both off.

share_learnings.title: Share anonymous learnings
share_learnings.description: Send anonymous trap filings and an anonymous usage count to Footgun. No source code is ever sent. Turn off to send neither.
